dedupe_keys.name: localisation des bornes electriques sur le territoire de douaisis agglo

description: Localisation des bornes électriques sur le territoire de DOUAISIS AGGLO is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DOUAISIS AGGLO. Location of electrical terminals in the territory of DOUAISIS AGGLO (CAD). Coverage: DOUAISIS AGGLO. The portal shows the English title as "Location of electrical terminals in the territory of DOUAISIS AGGLO" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DOUAISIS AGGLO. Its keywords include electriques, 22-kva, bornes-de-recharge, douaisis, douai, nord. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
